asset_scope: Positions and ordered triangle indices only; edge list derived from triangles. UV/color/normal/material payloads excluded. Not compared against full GLB bytes.
scope: Mesh core only: exact Float32 position bytes, original face counts and ordered indices, explicit edge endpoints. No general-purpose compression. IDs and original face/corner/edge order preserved. Bit-pattern and loose-edge stress cases included.
memory_scope: retained_payload_bytes counts final position/index/count arrays, excluding managed object headers and input packet. allocated_bytes is measured per decode on the current thread and includes output plus transient managed allocations; it is not peak process RAM, GPU memory, or native allocation.
timing: Per packet: fresh process; 25 warmups, then 9 batches of 25 decodes; report median per-decode elapsed time. Allocating and reusable-output timings are both recorded. Input already in memory. Raw baseline bulk-copies all source arrays. Both fresh and reused outputs are checked for exact reconstruction. Not disk I/O, triangulation, GPU upload, or a complete ZPM loader.
